title: When Agents Translate Code to Go, Do They Bring the Source Language With Them?
description: In the 2025 Go survey, 33% named Go idioms a top frustration. Our hypothesis: agents translating Java or Python to Go keep exceptions and thread-local state.
og_alt: Editorial card reading Go Syntax, Java Architecture, for an article on the source-language habits AI agents may carry into code they translate to Go.
